intelligence.enrichment: The place where plants and animals live is their habitat; plants and animals that live on land are in terrestrial habitats, those that live in water are in aquatic habitats, and animals such as frogs that live in water as well as on land are amphibians. place_where_organism_lives -> habitat_classification_and_survival_need The learner correctly applies this rule: The place where plants and animals live is their habitat; plants and animals that live on land are in terrestrial habitats, those that live in water are in aquatic habitats, and animals such as frogs that live in water as well as on land are amphibians. Habitat means the place where an animal was seen once, so land and water categories can change with one sighting.
